data.description: Pier Point 2: Elegant Residences in Dubai’s Marina District
data.long_description:
Experience luxury living at Pier Point 2, a premier residential development by Emaar in Dubai’s Rashid Yachts & Marina district. This refined complex comprises two elegant 12-story towers connected by a scenic podium, with each residence thoughtfully designed to enhance space and natural light.

Residence Options:
Choose from a range of upscale residences, from stylish one-bedroom apartments to expansive three-bedroom homes. Each unit features high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows, framing stunning views and providing a bright, airy atmosphere.

World-Class Amenities:
Pier Point 2 offers exceptional amenities that elevate daily living. Enjoy an exclusive infinity pool with marina views, a state-of-the-art fitness center, dedicated children’s play areas, and an extensive landscaped podium perfect for relaxation and social gatherings, with lush gardens and recreation spaces for all ages.

Unbeatable Location:
Positioned in a prime location, Pier Point 2 provides easy access to Dubai’s iconic destinations. Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Creek Harbour are all within a 15-20 minute drive, making it a perfect choice for those seeking a sophisticated lifestyle near the city’s finest attractions.
